english: Hmm~. I'm boooored.\nWon't someone play with meee?
Koto. What are you doing?
Oh!\nHey hey. You free right now?
If you are, play with me, won't you?\nI've got no one to play with and it's a problem~.
Play...,\nif it's games in my room that's fine, but...
Ehh! That's no fun!\nLet's go outside, outside!
Playing inside a room\nis just not something I can do, I'm telling you!
Playing in your room is fun too, you know.
Hmm. Maybe, but right now\nI'm in the mood to go wild\noutside!
I'm not good at playing outside.
That's no good. Are you even\na boy?
When I was in Kyōto,\nI played outside every single day, you know?
Running around on rooftops and stuff,\nsmashing up the town like crazy.\nIt was sooo fun~.
Smashing up the town - what kind of playing is that...
Normal stuff. Like tag?
In Kyōto there was Shoko-chan,\nthe greatest playmate ever.
She had tons of underlings,\nand every day they'd all\nplay with me.
They'd come charging at me in cars,\nblasting away with pistols and stuff...
And I'd take them all together\nand KAKIIIN with my hammer -\na home run. The end.
Then, 'let's play again tomorrow!' and done.
That... doesn't sound like THEY thought they were playing...
Well, yeah. But if it was fun, same thing, right!
To me it's playing, playing!\nHeheh.
So, what do you say.\nI want you to play with me\nkind of like that.
Umm... I'll have to pass.
Ehh, why why why!?
I mean, you're free, right?\nSo what's the harm. Hang out with me~.
Hearing all that, I don't think\nI have the stamina to keep up\nwith your kind of playing...
Ehh, I don't think stamina has anything to do with it.\nPlaying together would totally be fun, I bet.
Wouldn't it be better to invite\nsomeone other than me?
Hmm, I guess~.\nWell, if you say you don't wanna, can't be helped.
I'll go ask someone else. Later!
Uwaaah.\nBored bored bored bored~.
Don't tell me that...\nWeren't you going to play with someone else?
Everyone looks pretty busy, you know?\nI'd feel bad getting in their way.
Hm? You're making a face like\n'so it's fine to get in MY way?',\nare you?
I mean, you're free, right?\nYou've got that aura drifting off you.
I am free, it's true, but...
See~? Heheh.\nBeing free and all alone\nis boring, right?
So I came to play with you.\nYep, yep.
I've got things to do too, you know.
What the heck~.\nWhy tell such an obvious lie~.
You wanna chase me off that badly?\nHow rude~.
There's really no one besides you\nI could invite.
Hey, still no good? Can't play?\nI even thought up a game\nthat you might enjoy...
A game I'd enjoy?\nWhat's that?
Oh, interested now?\nHeh-heh. Then I'll tell you!
I name it!\n'Fly Away! Midair Catch Grand Plan!'
...How's that!?
'How' doesn't quite cover it...\nCould I get an explanation?
Okay, first you get one ball.\nThen I launch it with my hammer!
After that, YOU get launched too!
Huh?
Then you go soaring up through the clouds,\nand make a spectacular midair CAAATCH!
How's that!? Sounds fun, right!
It does NOT sound fun!\nThat's a punishment game!
Huh, where?
I mean, don't you wanna fly in the sky?\nI'd wanna fly.
I'm the one who can use the hammer,\nso I gave you the flying role.
To be called a punishment game...\na little disappointing.
Hmm... Koto and I seem to have\ndifferent scales of play...
...I guess~.
Ahh. When I was in Kyōto it was fun.\nEvery day was like a festival.
Maybe I just got used to that.\nI only wanna play normally, though...
No - no moping! I decided\nto go on this journey myself.
Complaining would be out of line. I know that.\nI've gotta put up with wanting to play a little.
Yeah! Sorry.\nI talked weird stuff at you.\nI'll go back to my room and be quiet.
...I'm not doing the midair catch, you know?
Huh?
If you guarantee my safety...\nI could play with you a little.
Really!?
Sheesh! You're a good guy~\nA really good guy~! Ahahaha!
Then let's go right now!\nWhatcha wanna do, whatcha wanna do~?
Let's not today.\nIt's almost dinner time.
Oh, you're right!\nWhen did it get so late.
Then play with me sometime, okay?\nIt's a promise? If you break a promise I'll rampage, got it?
Rampaging sounds scary.\nI'll remember the promise.\nSome other time.
Yeah! Some other time!\nFor now it's food, food!\nYou come too!
I came to collect on our promise!
What's with the surprised face~.\nDon't tell me you forgot what promise?
The promise to play together, right.
Heheh. Exactly!
I've been looking forward to it.\nCome on, let's go play!
Sorry. What was it again?

Geez, why'd you forget!
We promised to play together!
Once you promise, 'I forgot' is no excuse!
I'm dragging you out!
I think we should play to\nYOUR strengths here!
My strengths?\nI don't have any...
Why talk like that?\nYou DO have good points!
It's your running-away legs!
My running-away legs...?
Yeah! When you're fighting,\nyou're super quick when you\nrun or dodge, right.
I've always thought that was amazing.\nI think it's artistic running-away legs!
I mean, normal people\ncan't run away that fast!\nYou're a running-away genius! A god-given talent!
...Huh?\nWhy the disgusted face?
...I mean, it's not cool.\nHaving running-away legs as my good point.
It's not like that, y'know.
I think it's cool.\nI mean, it's something you're better at than people.
Just puff your chest out.\n'My running-away legs are the best in the land!\nI'll outrun everyone!' Like that.
Doesn't that sound uncool...?
Not uncool!\nYour running-away legs ARE cool! Yep!
She declared it...\n(But I'm a little happy...)
So, playing with the Running-Away King\nhimself, with such cool running-away legs...
It's gotta be tag, right! JAKIIIN!
...I get that we're playing tag,\nbut why are you holding the hammer?
I mean,\nplaying for real is the only fun way, right.
I'll chase you for real,\nso you run for real too!
Otherwise your good point won't come out,\nand it's more fun for me that way!
Whatever happened to guaranteeing\nmy safety...?
What's this genius saying.\nYou've got the best running-away legs in the land!
Believe in your legs!\nThen you'll be fine! Definitely fine!
That's so unreasonable...
It's not unreasonable!\nCome on, we're starting soon?
You promised to play with me,\nso you're sticking with me till I'm satisfied, got it?
W-wait a sec...
No waiting! Tag STAAART!\nTOOORYAAA!
Wawawawa~!?
(Will my body survive this!?\nFor now, run for real~!)
Man, playing together the other day\nwas fun~.
More grueling than fun.\nMy whole body was sore after...
Ahaha. Sore muscles, he says.\nHow old-man-like~.
That's 'cause you never move your body normally!\nThat's why it happens, I'm telling you!
This isn't that kind of story!\nI mean, it was tag, and\nyou were swinging the hammer for real!
I mean, you kept not getting hit!\nI was shocked!
Even when I thought 'gotcha!',\nyou'd slip away at the last second.
That was godlike~\nI was impressed just watching.
So I went 'come here, you~' and\ngot a little serious. Haha.
There you go laughing again...\nYou were laughing while chasing me too, right?
I mean, your face while running away\nwas so funny~.
I crack up just remembering it now.\nKukuku...
Ah, are you mad? Sorry sorry.\nI'm not making fun of you.
Anyway, it was fun~\nMaybe the most since I was in Kyōto.
How about you?\nDid you have fun playing with me?
Yeah. It was fun.
Right~? Heheh.\nIf you think so too,\nthat makes me happy.
Still, I like playing in my room better.
What the heck~. Don't say that~\nI'll sulk, you know~?
Y'know, I think I like\nplaying with you.
Huh...?
Like, maybe\nI had you a little wrong.
You barely talk, gloomy vibe -\nI thought you were some boring guy.
But playing together, I saw\nwhat a fun, kind guy you are.
You kept saying no no while running,\nbut you stuck with me to the end~.
You're a good guy! I like you!
...Ah, thank you.
What're you thanking me for, weirdo~.\nNothing to thank me for. Ahaha.
Anyway, it was super fun.\nThanks for hanging out with me!
If you're satisfied, Koto,\nthen I'm glad.
Satisfied, satisfied! Totally satisfied!\nGotta move your body to play, that's for sure.
Hey, can I ask you to play again sometime?\nI'll come invite you!
Got it. Invite me anytime.
Alright, well said! I won't forget!\nI'll invite you like crazy~.
Well, later!
Heeey. You in there~?
Koto. What's up?
What's up, she says -\nI came, so figure it out~.
You know what I came for, right?
An invitation to a date?
Whoa!? You made a joke!
Whew~. First time I've seen that.\nSaw something rare...
I'll worship it as a memento.\nMight bring some divine favor...
Sorry, I don't get it.
Ehh, what a letdown~.\nI thought we were on the same wavelength.
Still, 'I don't get it' - what's that about~.\nCan't you at least laugh it off lightly?
Hmm. Asking that's harsh, I guess.\nYou don't seem like the joking type.
Whatever, that doesn't matter!\nI came, so obviously\nit's a playdate invite!
Again...?\nWe just played together the other day, right?
You mean the no-touching-the-ground-rules\ntag from that time?
That was a masterpiece~\nWe both ran around on rooftops!
And your face when you almost fell!\nKukuku...
Come on. That's no laughing matter.
It was fun, so it's fine~\nSo, what'll we do today?
We've gotta throw in a new rule.\nNo ingenuity and it'll get boring!
I was thinking -\nhow about roping other people in?
We prank someone who looks like they'd get mad,\nthen you and I run away! How's that?\nHow's that? Sounds fun, right?
The question is who to target.\nI think someone who'd get REALLY mad\nwould be more fun, but...
...Um, Koto.\nCould you give me a pass today?
Hm? Why~?
You're gonna say old-man stuff again,\nlike it's too much for your stamina or sore muscles?
Come on, come on, that stuff!\nPlaying will fix it! Let's go together~!
W-wait a second.\nI'm really wiped, I'm telling you.
...That much?
You're way too energetic, Koto - keeping up\nwith you is tough on me.
Huh...?
I like playing with you, Koto,\nand I think it's really fun.\nBut playing almost every day is a bit...
...I see. So that's how it was.
Sorry, I guess?\nI thought I was just playing\nnormally, but...
You don't need to apologize, Koto.\nIt's my lack of stamina that's the problem.
Hmm, but...
Don't worry about it - invite me again.\nWhen I've got stamina, I'm fine.
Yeah...
Well, I've got something to do.\nLater.
If I could just\nplay inside rooms a little more... Hmm...
What do you even do\nto play inside a room...?
Ah, Koto. Another playdate invite?\nToday I can go outside, it's fine.
Ah - um, today it's different...
I did come to play,\nbut I thought I'd change things up a bit.
Today, I brought this! Ta-daa!
Is this... a doll?
Let me introduce them!\nThis slightly homely bunny is\nBunny Doll-kun!
And this golden robot is\nBishamaru Doll-kun!
I wanna play with these today -\nwill you hang out with me?
I see. So you launch the dolls as hard as you can\nand measure the distance, something like that?
No! I wouldn't do that!\nJust playing with dolls normally!
Hmm. You've got a 'not getting it' face...\nSo, um...
Girls are into this stuff, y'know?\nLike, playing with dolls, see?
B-Bunny boy! Welcome, come on in~\nOh, please, come on up~ ...stuff like that.
Y'know, that kind of thing!\nThat's what I wanna try with you.
Why would you do something so unlike you?
Shuuut up! It's fine!\nCall it a change of heart!
Sounds fun. Let's do it.
Wow, classic indoor type.\nYou just accepted it, no questions asked.\nImpressive...
Okay, let's do it.\nUm... w-what should I do?
Basically, I just have to go\nplay at the other person's house...
I'll do it like when I visited Yase's place.\nYeah, that's the image... okay.
B-Bunny boooy!\nI came to plaaay! Let's play togetheeer!
Hey there, Bishamaru-kun.\nI just finished baking cookies.\nWon't you have some?
C...cookies...\nYou... baked cookies...?\nKukukuku...
It wasn't me, the bunny doll baked them!\nAnd don't laugh!
Ah, sorry.\nIt was just so ridiculous.\nKukuku...
No, no, this won't do.\nI'll do it properly! Okay...
R-right. Cookies, huh.\nNo wonder it smells sweet.\nWell, excuse me for intruding...
...Take this! Bishamaru Hammer!\nZugan-zugan-zugagaaaan!!
Dammit, the bunny ears are turning into machine guns!\nZudadadada!!
Kakin-kakin-kakiin!\nThat won't work on Bishamaru!
Finisher! Bishamaru Laser!\nDogogoooon!
Gyaaah! I'm done for!
W-wait, nooo!\nThis is how boys play!
When did this turn into a fight?\nUgh, this isn't working!
Was it? I had fun, though.
I had fun too, but it was supposed to be\nway more girly!
It's kind of frustrating...\nIt makes me look like a girl who can't play girly.
Well then, maybe I'll just\nmaster this whole girly thing...
What are you mumbling about?
Huh? Oh, nothing at all.\nAhahaha!
I've got something to think about.\nSee ya!
What was that about...\nAh, she left her doll behind.
Ah. Um... got a minute?
Actually, there's something I wanna ask...\nHmm. How should I put this...
It's kind of an embarrassing thing...\nUm... will you promise me something?
Whatever I say from here on,\npromise you won't tell anyone. Ever.
Understood. I promise.
Really?\nOkay, I'll take your word for it.
I think... it'll probably be fine.
Why are you being so wishy-washy?!\nPromise me properly!\nDon't tell a soul!
Okay... I'll say it.\nBut don't laugh or anything, okay?
Um... what do I have to do\nto become a cuter girl?
W-what's with that face?!\nDon't look at me like you saw something impossible!
S-sorry.\nIt was just such an unexpected question.
Something this embarrassing,\nI can't ask anyone else.\nYou're the only one I can ask.
Please.\nHelp me figure out how to become cuter.
Does it... have to be me?
Yes!
But I don't really know about that stuff...
No!\nIf you won't help me, I'll rampage!
Even if you say that... hmm...
...I won't rampage, y'know?
I know.\nI know you're not someone who'd go rampaging.
Eheheh.\nSee, you really do understand me.
That's why I want your help.\nYou hang out with me all the time, so you'd know\nwhat's wrong with me and stuff, right?
Anything, just tell me.\nBe honest with me, please!
Then, may I give you my truly honest opinion?
Yeah! I'm listening!
I'm even sitting seiza-style to listen!\nOkay, go ahead! Please!
I think you're a perfectly cute girl just as you are.
Nngh!?
I-I see.\nAh, really... um...
Ah, ahahaha. I don't even\nknow what face to make right now.
Can I ask you something in return?\nWhy did you start worrying about this?
Why, does it matter?
No, I'm curious.\nLike suddenly playing with dolls...
That was because I wanted\nto play with you more.
We finally got close, and I hated\ndragging you outside by force\nand causing you trouble because of it.
I figured if I could play indoors,\nI could hang out with you more.
(It was all for me...)
But then that doll play turned\ninto a battle before I knew it.
As a girl, how's that look, huh?\nTahaha...
So I wanted to try aiming for\nthat 'cute girl' thing, just once...
I see... so you thought\nI was cute.
Heheh. That kinda makes me happy.
(Ugh. S-she's cute. Koto-san.)
I'm glad I asked you.\nI got to hear something wonderful.
Well, see ya!\nI'll think about what we play next!
(She got that happy over my words...\nCould it be that Koto-san... likes me?)
...Um, what is this place?
Ah!\nYou came!
Koto-san? Are you in this room?\nUm... Café SHC?
Jeez, still half asleep?\nI'm the one who called you!
Just come in!\nI wanna show you something already!
Show me...?\nI don't really get it, but I should come in, right?
Oookay, here we gooo.\nReaaady...
Tadaaa!
K-Koto-san?\nWhat are you wearing!?
Aha, hahaha.\nActually, this is closer to my everyday wear.
...Um, the other day, you\ncalled me cute, remember?
That made me sooo happy.\nSo I thought I'd dress more girly too.
So I wondered what kind of clothes you'd like,\nand I thought and thought and thought...
I thought too hard and came full circle back to my everyday clothes.\nHahaha...
Is it too plain?
N-no, not at all!\nGetting to see your everyday look is the best!
Really!?\nEheheh. That makes me happy.
Okay, today I'm gonna give you\nsome special treatment, got it?
You saw the sign outside, right? This is Café SHC.\nAnd I'm your own personal waitress!
Say anything you want.\nI'll grant any wish.
Why are you standing so far away?\nCome closer!
I-is that okay?
Of course it is.\nCome on, come closer.
Okay!\nThen I'll come closer right now...
H-huh? I want to go closer, but my feet won't move.\nHuh? Huhhh?
...What are you doing?
H-huh? Koto-san!?\nWhat happened to the outfit from before!?
The outfit from before...?\nWhat kind of dream were you having?
D-dream...?\nSo all of that was a dream...?
Nihihihih~!
You were having a weird dream~.\nI'll just have to tell everyone about this! ♪
W-wait a minute!
No way!\nI can't pass up something this funny!
Hey, everyone!\nThis guy was having a weird dream!
Gather 'round!\nLet's hear what kind of dream it was!\nAhahaha!
P-please stop! Koto-san!\nStoooop!
